topic: The Unified Language of Exponents, Roots, and Logarithms

sections.title: The Foundation: Powers as Growth (1 Minute)
lecture_lines: Base b raised to x equals y.
This is the foundation of growth.
Base, exponent, and power are linked.
animations: Create a base number 'b' (#FFFFFF) and an exponent 'x' (#FF0000) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/abacus.svg].
Represent the growth equation: b raised to x equals y (#00FF00).
Display the calculation: 2 raised to 3 equals 8 (#FFFF00) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg].
Draw an exponential curve rising from left to right on the screen using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
Highlight the relationship between b (#FFFFFF), x (#FF0000), and y (#00FF00) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/counter.svg].

sections.title: Roots: The Inverse of the Exponent (1 Minute)
lecture_lines: We find the base when growth is known.
Calculate base from volume and time.
animations: Display y (#00FF00) and the radical symbol (#FFFFFF) representing the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/container.svg].
Show the root operation extracting the base b (#FFFFFF) from the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/container.svg] y (#00FF00).
Calculate the base given the total volume y (#00FF00) of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg].

sections.title: Logarithms: Searching for the Time/Rate (1.5 Minutes)
lecture_lines: How long to reach a value?
animations: Label base b (#FFFFFF) and total y (#00FF00) on the screen.
Place a box for the unknown exponent x (#FF0000) between b and y.
Introduce the log symbol as the tool to find x (#FF0000) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg].
Connect log_b(y) = x (#FFFF00) as the final equation.
Animate a search pointer identifying x (#FF0000) from b and y [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifyingglass.svg].

sections.title: The Unified Triangle: Visual Synthesis (1 Minute)
lecture_lines: Powers, roots, and logs are unified.
Visualize b, x, and y together.
animations: Create a triangle with corners Base (#FFFFFF), Exponent (#FF0000), Total (#00FF00) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg] to represent the spectral decomposition of the relationship.
Draw directed arrows indicating the relationship between the three corners.
Highlight the logarithmic vertex as the unique way to find the exponent.
Rearrange the equations inside the triangle to show their symmetry.
Pulse the entire triangle to emphasize the unified perspective, overlaying a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] to indicate directionality and orientation.

sections.title: Quick Check & Conclusion (0.5 Minutes)
lecture_lines: Summary: powers, roots, and logs match.
animations: Display: b^x = y (#FFFFFF), x = log_b(y) (#FF0000), and y^(1/x) = b (#00FF00).
Present 5^x = 125, show x calculation steps.
Display 'x = 3' clearly in bold yellow (#FFFF00).
